WITH date_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001
),
demo_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk AS cd_demo_sk,
           cd_dep_count AS cd_dep_count
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
      AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
),
customer_filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT c.c_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk,
           c.c_birth_year AS c_birth_year,
           ca.ca_country AS ca_country,
           ca.ca_state AS ca_state,
           ca.ca_county AS ca_county
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    WHERE c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
)
SELECT i.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
       cf.ca_country AS ca_country,
       cf.ca_state AS ca_state,
       cf.ca_county AS ca_county,
       AVG(cs.cs_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(cs.cs_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(cs.cs_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(cs.cs_sales_price) AS agg4,
       AVG(cs.cs_net_profit) AS agg5,
       AVG(cf.c_birth_year) AS agg6,
       AVG(dm.cd_dep_count) AS agg7
FROM customer_filtered cf
JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = cf.c_customer_sk
JOIN date_filtered df ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = df.d_date_sk
JOIN demo_filtered dm ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = dm.cd_demo_sk
JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, cf.ca_country, cf.ca_state, cf.ca_county)
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
